# UAE says it rescued 22 people from burning cargo ship in Sea of Oman
By Reuters

The United Arab Emirates National Guard announced it successfully rescued 22 individuals following a fire outbreak aboard a cargo vessel in the Sea of Oman. According to the statement, "all of whom are Arab nationals" were rescued from the burning ship.

The brief report provided limited additional details about the incident, the vessel's origin, or circumstances surrounding the fire.
